```{r}

Predict_Data <- Clean2024_2025_Data_2 %>% select(-GameKey, -Season, -AwayTeam, -HomeTeam, -AwayGameNumber, -HomeGameNumber, -Date) 

dpredict <- xgb.DMatrix(data = as.matrix(Predict_Data %>% select(-OT)), label = Predict_Data$OT)

```

```{r}
boost_preds <- predict(bst_final_MaxAUCPR, dpredict) # Create predictions for xgboost model
# Join predictions and actual
pred_dat <- cbind.data.frame(boost_preds , Predict_Data$OT)
names(pred_dat) <- c("predictions", "response")

#oc<- optimal.cutpoints(X = "predictions",
#                       status = "response",
#                       tag.healthy = 0,
#                       data = pred_dat,
#                       methods = "MaxEfficiency")

#boost_preds_MaxAUC <- predict(bst_final_MaxAUC, dtest) # Create predictions for xgboost model

#pred_dat <- cbind.data.frame(boost_preds_MaxAUC , test_db$OT)#
# Convert predictions to classes, using optimal cut-off
boost_pred_class <- rep(0, length(boost_preds))
#boost_pred_class[boost_preds >= cutoffvalue] <- 1
#0.5400651
boost_pred_class[boost_preds >= .425] <- 1


t <- table(boost_pred_class, actual = Predict_Data$OT) # Create table
confusionMatrix(t, positive = "1") # Produce confusion matrix
```

```{r}
testcuttoffs <- seq(from = 0.4, to = 0.46, by = 0.0001)


Results <- data.frame()

for (i in testcuttoffs) {
 
  
boost_preds <- predict(bst_final_MaxAUCPR, dpredict) # Create predictions for xgboost model
# Join predictions and actual
pred_dat <- cbind.data.frame(boost_preds , Predict_Data$OT)
names(pred_dat) <- c("predictions", "response")
  
boost_pred_class <- rep(0, length(boost_preds))  

boost_pred_class[boost_preds >= i] <- 1


t <- table(boost_pred_class, actual = Predict_Data$OT) # Create table
m <- confusionMatrix(t, positive = "1") # Produce confusion matrix

PosPred <- m[["byClass"]][["Pos Pred Value"]]


newrow <- data.frame(Cuffoff = i, PosPredValue = PosPred)

Results <- rbind(Results, newrow)


}
```

```{r}
cbind(Clean2024_2025_Data_2 %>% select(GameKey, HomeTeam, AwayTeam, Date, OT), boost_preds, boost_pred_class) %>% arrange(desc(Date))
```

```{r}
Clean2024_2025_Data_2 %>% group_by(month(Date)) %>% summarise(sum(OT), n(), sum(OT/n()))
```

```{r}
cbind(Clean2024_2025_Data_2 %>% select(GameKey, HomeTeam, AwayTeam, Date, OT), boost_preds, boost_pred_class) %>% mutate(CorrectGuess = boost_pred_class == 1 & OT == 1) %>%  group_by(month(Date)) %>% summarise(sum(OT), n(), sum(OT/n()), sum(boost_pred_class), sum(CorrectGuess), sum(CorrectGuess)/sum(boost_pred_class))
```
